en.title: Thai Airways Boeing 787-9 returns to Shanghai after cracked windshield
en.summary: A Thai Airways Boeing 787-9 operating flight TG-663 from Shanghai Pudong to Bangkok stopped its climb at 9,000 feet after its windshield cracked, dumped fuel and returned to Pudong for a safe landing about 80 minutes after departure.
body: A Thai Airways Boeing 787-9, registration HS-TWA, was operating flight TG-663 from Shanghai Pudong to Bangkok when the crew stopped the climb at 2,700 metres (9,000 feet) after a windshield cracked. The aircraft had departed from Pudong's runway 17L and, after dumping fuel, returned to the airport for a safe landing on runway 16R about 80 minutes after departure.

The aircraft was still on the ground about 13 hours after landing, according to The Aviation Herald's report on the incident. No injuries or further damage were reported in the account, which describes the return as a precautionary response to the cracked windshield during climb.

facts.claim: A Thai Airways Boeing 787-9, registration HS-TWA, operating flight TG-663 from Shanghai Pudong to Bangkok, stopped its climb at 2,700 metres (9,000 feet) due to a cracked windshield after departing runway 17L.
The aircraft dumped fuel and returned to Pudong for a safe landing on runway 16R about 80 minutes after departure.
The aircraft was still on the ground about 13 hours after landing.

zh.title: 泰航787-9上海起飛後風擋裂紋返航平安降落
zh.summary: 泰國航空一架波音787-9客機執飛上海浦東往曼谷TG-663航班，爬升至9000英尺時因風擋裂紋停止爬升，傾倒燃油後約80分鐘返航浦東平安降落。
body: 泰國航空一架波音787-9客機、註冊編號HS-TWA，執飛上海浦東往曼谷的TG-663航班，自浦東17L跑道起飛爬升時，機組因風擋裂紋在2700公尺、約9000英尺高度停止爬升。該機傾倒燃油後返航浦東，約在起飛80分鐘後於16R跑道平安降落。
根據航空先驅報的報導，該機落地約13小時後仍停留在地面。報導將此次返航描述為爬升階段發現風擋裂紋後的預防性處置，文中未提及人員受傷或進一步損傷。
